title: OSN-26 cross-OS token discovery (ports.json + AppData/XDG fallback) and --signed-udp-ping CLI flags in susi-conformance
goal: Add pure cross-OS token file resolution resolve_default_token_file_with supporting SUSI_HOME ports.json api_token_path, existing ~/.susi, and OSN-26 platform config fallbacks (%APPDATA%/susi, ~/Library/Application Support/susi, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/susi / ~/.config/susi), extract parse_cli_args exposing --signed-udp-ping and --signed-udp-pong-prefix on the susi-conformance CLI, and add unit tests in crates/susi-conformance/src/bin/susi-conformance.rs (OSN-26, B8; landed in 109a7fae3 #1387).

reuse.reason: Extended the existing susi-conformance binary entrypoint and Optional/Target configuration types directly inside crates/susi-conformance/src/bin/susi-conformance.rs (landed in squash commit 109a7fae323c38dbfaa5a6fbbc173474f81710d6 #1387) without adding new crates or external dependencies.
